notes.title: Pao Pao Big Demo Update
notes.notes:
Step into the colorful, heartwarming world of Pao Pao — an open-world adventure where you play as a fluffy little restaurant owner on a peaceful island archipelago. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029753/e80739027af6c94dce920c8fd16fb4124cfb2f43.png"]

🍲 What is Pao Pao? A cozy sandbox game that blends story-driven quests, gentle exploration, resource gathering, farming, and co-op gameplay. Spend your days cooking, crafting, making friends with island locals — or just wandering through lush landscapes at your own pace.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029753/3027e26313b3e47a9a1872157103626eca5d8ffc.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029753/31835702a4f3e0eb061f0fcfb9596711469a4d00.png"]

✨ Pao Pao stands out with its vibrant art style, soothing atmosphere, and a living world full of small but delightful details. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029753/b6811657469e754b7d44d731e909c933dd7110a6.png"]

🧺 Slow down, settle in, and discover a world that rewards curiosity and kindness. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029753/98b85f0152d908654b53a99aa236ec7a7bb47e40.png"]🎮 Try the updated Pao Pao demo now — free on Steam!  

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024130/Pao_Pao/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: BIG SALE & UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello, gamers!

Welcome to the long-awaited update of Last Hope Bunker: Zombie Survival! Our team has put all their heart and time into making your gaming experience more exciting. But let's go through everything step by step.

Firstly, you can now purchase Last Hope Bunker: Zombie Survival at an incredibly low price with an 85% discount! The offer is limited, so hurry up!

Secondly, we have added near 40 easter eggs to all game locations! While playing Last Hope Bunker: Zombie Survival, you will come across various references to famous streamers and personalities from the gaming industry, as well as memes, cultural phenomena, and legendary games. Protecting the world from zombies is great, of course, but don't forget to explore the game's surroundings, which can offer a lot of interesting things!

Can you find all the easter eggs? Share your experience on our Discord https://discord.gg/vDt3GXdv and compare your results with other players.

And lastly. In addition to adding easter eggs, we have fixed several bugs that you pointed out earlier. So we hope that your new experience will be better than the previous one.
